scope.logits: Every vocabulary logit at every fixture position is compared.
scope.gradients: Every parameter is sampled: all vector entries; 16 random matrix rows plus first/last rows and input-token embedding rows.

checks_passed: Exact original and scaled baseline parameter counts
Parameter counts for sharing including shared LayerNorms, deletion, narrowing, loops, and transpose tying
Transpose tying forward math and gradient flow
Packed versus individual conversation logits, weighted losses, and all parameter gradients
No forward or gradient leakage across conversation boundaries
No forward leakage from future tokens
Dense masked cross entropy versus optimized answer-only vocabulary projection, including chunked projection and all gradients
Warmup and total-step-dependent cosine learning rate schedule
MLX original-frame forward/loss/gradient parity for baseline and all-primitives composite with injection enabled and disabled
Installed MLX uncorrected AdamW versus adapted PyTorch AdamW: four updates, all parameters and first/second moments, clipping, varying learning rates, and resume after update two

optimizer_parity.implementation: Adapt standard PyTorch AdamW learning rate, epsilon, and decay each step to reproduce uncorrected MLX AdamW while retaining fused CUDA kernels.

limitations: This verifies arithmetic on synthetic inputs and optimizer updates; it does not establish CUDA throughput or a 5000-step training result.
Full training curves need not be identical across MLX and CUDA because random number generators, dropout masks, and floating-point kernels differ.
BF16 training stability and GPU fused-kernel behavior require the pending GPU checks.
